summary: First exact-PDF assessment of the 40-page revision dated 17 November 2026. Recommend circulation as a mathematical working paper with its historical version note. A stationary density can converge to one at the distinguished vertex while the potential grows exponentially there and its noise average decays exponentially. The full spectrum stays exponentially close to Boolean noise in the constructed family. This excludes a plausible mechanism for proving a uniform gap. The result is model-specific. The reviewer shares the preparation context, had access to earlier results and issued this assessment once. Editorial acceptance and independent peer review are outside this recommendation.
strengths: Pages 25-28: the two rare Hamming shells have separated one-step and two-step means. The enlarged exceptional set controls the stationary floor off both shells. The bound G >= exp(-epsilon L) is sufficient because the shell probabilities beat its cost in the critical norm.

Page 22: for T=(I-K)/2 the absolute row sum is at most one, and its stationary L2 norm is at most one half. Splitting the series at the logarithmic crossover controls reconstruction without assuming a top spectral gap.

Pages 27-28: the low Walsh correction costs at most exp(o(L)) times an exponentially small coefficient. Positive reconstruction gives multiplicative control of both numerator and denominator even where the denominator tends to zero.

Pages 28-30: after smoothing the potential the first-degree coefficient is proportional to ef times (tau^(2m+1)-tau), with ef nonzero. This distinguishes destruction of exact matching from any quantitative claim about the size of the defect.
weaknesses: The first-page abstract extends onto page two and is difficult to navigate. Three overfull lines are logged, the largest 30.7 pt. Contact sheets showed no missing pages or content extending past a page edge.

Section 16 is explicitly about the source state of 17 November. It cites v1 as the predecessor and predates compilation of this PDF. The version landing page must identify the actual v2 parent and date the build and this separate exact-PDF report.

No uniform control near rho endpoints, global novelty determination, unrestricted stationary-gap proof, human peer review or Lean check. The full scientific inspection emphasized Sections 10-12 and did not rederive every earlier theorem.
